title: Cross-company IDOR: the attacker company cannot read the victim's mapping, lines, post, reconcile or remove its month (404)
Cross-company: attaching the victim's import batch to the attacker company is refused (404)
CSRF: a POST with a wrong CSRF token is refused (403), on every R163 write route; a good-token read still works afterwards
Email-header injection: a company name with CRLF + a forged Bcc cannot inject a header; the stored subject is single-line
evidence: status 201; subject has no CRLF true; name stored without CRLF true; subject "Tegh: accountant requested by R163SEC Evil mv4q6g6m Bcc: attacker@evil.test ($0.00 CAD)"

title: Stored XSS: a <script> payload in a bank-line description is stored raw but returned as data (the client escapes it); the API never executes it
evidence: group IMG SRC|out; returned verbatim as JSON string: " ACME"

title: Integrity: a deposit for an HST registrant cannot be posted without a tax choice (server refuses, not only the UI)
Integrity: the client cannot mark a month reconciled by itself — reconcile with a wrong closing balance is refused with the difference
Abuse: accountant requests are capped at 5 per company per hour (the 6th is 429), so the mail path is not a relay
Secrets: the accountant review/quote never returns the hourly rate, the minutes per finding or the hours
Input bounds: an over-long note and a bad monthId are rejected cleanly (no 500)
